comment: M19 difficulty modes, chosen at a new run. permadeath: as designed. mercy: dying rewinds to the start of that day with a narrator quip. story: Permadeath rules but combat uses the 'story' difficulty (easier fights). The Journal records each run's mode.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.text: One life. The way the story was written.

mercy.name: Narrator's Mercy
mercy.text: Die, and the narrator rewinds the day. Once in a while.

story.name: Story
story.text: Easier fights. For the people, not the pain.

mercyQuips: "No. That's not how this goes." The narrator turns the page back.
"Let's try that again. I'll pretend I didn't see."
"Rewinding. Don't make me do this every day."
